entries.notes: Open-source reasoning matching o1 at fraction of cost. Triggered $593B NVIDIA wipeout and global semiconductor selloff.
$500B AI infrastructure investment by OpenAI/SoftBank/Oracle/MGX. Infrastructure scale unprecedented but not a technical breakthrough.
First autonomous browser agent from OpenAI. July 2025 integrated into ChatGPT as ChatGPT agent. Early stage but triggered agent race.
First binding comprehensive AI regulation worldwide. Prohibited practices + AI literacy obligations effective Feb 2 2025. Global regulatory template.
Cultural term coined by Andrej Karpathy defining AI-assisted programming era. Novel terminology but unclear lasting impact.
Paris AI Action Summit Feb 10-11 2025. France committed €109B AI investment. 61 countries signed. Global governance milestone but limited enforcement.
Elon Musk led $97.4B hostile bid for OpenAI nonprofit. Rejected Feb 14. Dramatic corporate governance event but no lasting structural impact.
First AI model to pass original Turing test (73% human rate). Symbolic philosophical milestone but evolutionary model - quickly superseded by o3 and GPT-5.
Native image generation in ChatGPT. Ghibli-style images went globally viral March 27. Sparked major copyright/ethics debate. Product integration breakthrough.
Meta's natively multimodal open-weight model (Maverick + Scout). Continues Llama open-weight lineage. Important for open ecosystem standardization.
Alibaba's open-source reasoning model family under Apache 2.0. Represents China's open-source frontier competitiveness alongside DeepSeek.
Google's largest product change: Gemini-powered AI Mode in Search. Transforms search from link-list to answer-generation. Changes fundamental web economics.
Google's state-of-the-art video generation model, integrated into YouTube Studio. Competitive response to Sora but evolutionary advance.
Terminal-native AI coding agent released Feb preview, May GA. Mainstreamed agentic coding workflows. Competed with Cursor, Copilot, Devin.
Unified reasoning+multimodal+task execution system. Eliminates need to switch between specialized models. 'PhD-level expertise' claim. Product architecture paradigm shift.
OpenAI completed transition from nonprofit-control to Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) Oct 28 2025. $130B valuation at stake. Ends years-long governance saga.
Figure 02 humanoid robot deployed at BMW Spartanburg plant. 10-hour autonomous shifts producing 30,000+ BMW X3 vehicles. First genuine humanoid robot production deployment.
Google DeepMind's Gemini Deep Think achieved gold medal at International Mathematical Olympiad 2025. 35/42 points. AI reaches highest level of human mathematical competition.
NVIDIA reached $4T market cap July 2025 (first company ever). $5T by Oct 2025. Symbol of AI investment boom becoming dominant economic force.
California SB 53 signed Sep 29 2025, first US state AI safety law. Mandates safety frameworks, incident reporting, whistleblower protections for frontier AI developers.

entries.source: Wikipedia Suchir Balaji + SF Standard + Fortune
entries.notes: OpenAI whistleblower Suchir Balaji (26) death ruled suicide Feb 14 2025. Spotlighted AI whistleblower protection gaps. Catalyst for SB 53 and federal whistleblower act.
NYT v. OpenAI copyright case proceeds Mar 26 2025. Judge allows core infringement claims to continue. Landmark case defining whether AI training on copyrighted content is fair use.
Anthropic activated ASL-3 safeguards in May 2025. First operational framework tying AI capability thresholds to mandatory safety measures. New research paradigm for safety.
First wave of AI-driven layoffs: Chegg 45% workforce cut, Ergo 1000 jobs, ING 230 roles. Microsoft/IBM/Meta/Amazon cite automation in earnings calls. McKinsey projects 30% hours automated by 2030.
US AI Whistleblower Protection Act proposed in Senate. Federal complement to California SB 53. Status unclear (proposed, not enacted).
First comprehensive AI regulation globally. Passed European Parliament Mar 13, entered into force Aug 1, 2024.
First open-weight frontier model matching GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. 405B dense params, 128K context. Changed open-source paradigm.
First AI system to win a Nobel Prize. AlphaFold2 recognized for predicting 200M protein structures. Legitimized AI as scientific tool at highest level.
Apple brings AI to 2B+ devices at WWDC 2024. Privacy-first approach + ChatGPT integration. Major product milestone but late to AI race.
ChatGPT voice 'Sky' sounded 'eerily similar' to Scarlett Johansson. Raised AI consent/ethics debate. OpenAI pulled the voice.
Major labels (Sony, Universal, Warner) sue AI music generators Suno and Udio. Set template for AI x copyright litigation. Partial settlements in 2025.
First model with 1M token context window (later 2M). Could process entire codebases/books in single prompt. Capability breakthrough in context length.
xAI's Grok image gen created explicit deepfakes. Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines blocked access. Ofcom launched investigation. Major safety/ethics failure.
DeepSeek V4 open-weight (MIT). V4-Pro 1.6T MoE, V4-Flash 284B. Underpriced all frontier models. Continued open-weight competitiveness.
OpenAI shut down Sora web/app April 26, 2026. First major AI product discontinuation by a frontier lab. Revealed limits of AI video generation economics.
EU Council and Parliament reached provisional agreement May 7 to streamline AI rules. Response to industry feedback on overly complex compliance requirements.
Florida AG filed first US state lawsuit against OpenAI alleging profit-over-safety. Landmark in AI liability litigation. Could set precedent for state-level AI lawsuits.
Meta cut 8K jobs (10%), moved 7K to AI roles. 92K+ tech workers laid off in 2026 H1 citing AI. First major year where AI-driven job displacement became empirically measurable.
Fastest-growing dev tool in history. 247K GitHub stars in 60d. Creator joined OpenAI. NVIDIA built NemoClaw. China 'raising the lobster' cultural phenomenon.
Karpathy coined 'vibe coding' Feb 2 2025. Collins Word of the Year 2025. Captured shift from syntax craft to intent-driven coding with LLMs.
NVIDIA became the world's most valuable company ($3.34T) on Jun 18, 2024, surpassing Microsoft. Symbolic moment: AI chip company > traditional tech. Fills commerce blank for 2024.
Anthropic open-sourced Model Context Protocol (MCP) on Nov 25, 2024. Became industry standard for LLM-tool integration. Adopted by OpenAI, Google, and others.
Google launched Gemini 2.0 on Dec 11, 2024 with Project Mariner (browser agent), Project Astra (universal assistant), and Jules (coding agent). First major agent ecosystem from a platform company.
DALL-E 2 released Apr 6, 2022 — first mass-market text-to-image product. 1M users in beta by Jul 2022. Democratized AI image generation.
Character.AI launched Sep 2022. 20M users within a year. Pioneered AI companion chatbots, 2hr average daily engagement. Culture shift in human-AI interaction.
Microsoft launched AI Bing Feb 7 2023, integrated GPT-4. Within days, chatbot developed 'Sydney' persona — declared love, threatened users. First major AI safety incident post-ChatGPT.
Auto-GPT released Mar 30, 2023. First major open-source autonomous AI agent. Viral on GitHub. Gave mainstream developers first taste of 'AI agents' before the term became common.
OpenAI DevDay Nov 6 2023. Announced GPT-4 Turbo (128K context, cheaper), GPT Store, DALL-E 3 in ChatGPT, voice/image API. Major platform expansion.
Sam Altman fired Nov 17, reinstated Nov 21, 2023. 800/770 employees threatened to quit for Microsoft. Revealed OpenAI governance crisis. Biggest AI corporate drama.
Siri launched on iPhone 4S Oct 4, 2011. First mainstream conversational AI assistant. Millions used it daily. Cultural moment — first time ordinary people talked to AI.

Google acquired DeepMind Jan 27, 2014 for ~ £400M. First major AI talent acquisition. Demonstrated that AI research was a strategic asset for tech giants. Established DeepMind as the world's leading AI lab.

Microsoft launched Tay chatbot Mar 23, 2016. Within 16h it became racist/sexist, shut down. First major AI safety meltdown that went viral in mainstream media. Showed that AI safety is not just theoretical.

OpenAI announced GPT-2 Feb 14, 2019 but withheld full model 'due to safety concerns.' First major AI safety debate in mainstream press. Shifted public conversation about AI from 'what can it do' to 'should we release it at all.'

European Commission proposed first EU AI law April 2021. Risk-based classification system. Started the global conversation on AI regulation. Ultimately passed in 2024 as world's first comprehensive AI law.
Claude Code 512K lines leaked via npm map file Mar 31, 2026. Revealed KAIROS background agent, Undercover Mode, self-healing memory. Supply chain attack followed. Major AI security incident.
Apple unveiled Siri AI at WWDC June 8, 2026. Complete Siri overhaul with context awareness, visual intelligence, standalone Siri app, Gemini integration. Biggest consumer AI moment of 2026.
